StriederDrton2024PH and PerkovicKalischMaathuis2017: possible total effects are obtained by enumerating order/adjustment-set-induced regressions under structure uncertainty.
BelomestnyTrabsTsybakov2019: nonasymptotic characteristic-function covariance estimation at logarithmic rates.

BelomestnyTrabsTsybakov2019 gives covariance minimax lower bounds; the causal-fiber and honest-diameter transfer is conditional on the unresolved splice.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2 / project kernel
novelty_flags.one_line: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: the draft does not directly compare its finite-sample whole-fiber union with Wang--Kolar--Drton's published order-confidence-to-effect-CI construction (Algorithm 3 and Lemma 1), the closest causal-inference result.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition 3 (known-order reduction)
novelty_flags.one_line: This is the standard known-order conditional-regression formula already stated for total effects in StriederDrton2024PH; retain it only as an unnumbered sanity corollary.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 4 / Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The smooth Laplace--Student splice, including fixed-class membership and product-TV indistinguishability, is assumed only through an affirmative answer to the stated OEQ.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The covariance/effect minimax equivalences and honest-diameter event are claimed only conditional on a valid smooth-splice construction.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2--3, equations (1) and the total-effect regression formula; pp. 8--9, Theorem 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a known-DAG total effect as a conditional-regression coefficient and gives an asymptotic confidence set under structure uncertainty.
The paper adapts IDA and joint-IDA to compute multisets of possible total causal effects under background knowledge represented by maximal PDAGs.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Algorithm 3 and Lemma 1 in the paper text
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method forms a union of conditional total-effect confidence intervals across a confidence set of causal orderings, with asymptotic coverage accounting for model uncertainty.
The cited paper studies estimation of a latent Gaussian covariance from additively contaminated observations and establishes logarithmic minimax rates.
The paper develops fourth-moment ICA functionals, estimating equations, algorithms, and asymptotic statistical properties.

The paper states unique identification with known causal structure and finite identification, at most n! SCMs, when causal structure is unknown under Gaussian-noise/non-Gaussian-confounder assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make Theorem 2 a direct head-to-head result against Wang--Kolar--Drton: prove a finite-sample guarantee unavailable there and state a nonnested or strict model-regime comparison, including why latent mixed-noise greatest-divisor recovery cannot be reduced to their identifiable additive-error ordering model.
Promote the smooth-splice OEQ into an explicit constructed two-point experiment, then state the resulting causal-fiber lower bound as a matched frontier rather than a conditional transfer.
Demote Proposition 3 to a sanity corollary and sharpen the ideal-fiber result with a complexity or minimality claim that distinguishes it from published adjustment-set/order enumeration.

recommended_next_step: Revise around an explicit comparison with Wang--Kolar--Drton and a non-routine ideal-fiber or matched lower-bound advance before advancing this angle.
